info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Channel Activity Analysis API
info.description: The Channel Activity Analysis API provides insights into banking operational services by analyzing user interactions across various channels. This API enables financial institutions to track customer engagement and transaction trends, improving decision-making based on data derived from channel activity. Typical consumers include business analysts and operational managers who need to optimize channel performance and enhance customer experience. By utilizing this API, organizations can leverage actionable data to drive strategic initiatives and improve service delivery across their operational channels.

get.description: This endpoint provides analysis of channel activity within operational services, allowing users to assess the performance and effectiveness of various channels. It aggregates key metrics that help in decision-making regarding resource allocation and strategy refinement.
